why_this_exists: Step 293 built the first market-neutral book in this project and it cleared the orthogonality gate by construction -- correlation +0.030 to valuation and -0.044 to growth, market beta -0.009 with R2 0.001. That is the gate fourteen families died on before they ever reached a skill test. The signal in it, GGR pair convergence, had no skill. This experiment puts the reverse case: a signal with at least some demonstrated skill into the structure that removes the market factor.
why_cash_conversion_specifically: Step 289 tested all four dashboard signals out of sample on 2013-2022. Cash conversion is the ONLY one with both a positive excess over its own scored universe (+1.08pp) and a Sharpe above that universe (0.698 against 0.673). It retains 11% of its in-sample edge, which is weak, but the other three retained 3%, -75% and -131%. It is the only surviving candidate for 'a weak but real signal', and the question this experiment asks is whether the structure rescues one.

the_structure.long_leg: the same top 20 by cash-conversion score that the frozen long-only book holds, so the long leg is identical and the experiment isolates exactly what the short leg adds
the_structure.short_leg: the bottom 20 by the same score, same sector-neutral ranking
the_structure.weighting: 50% gross long and 50% gross short, so total gross exposure is 100% and the book is directly comparable to the long-only version's 100%, rather than the 200% a conventional 100/100 dollar-neutral book would carry
the_structure.cadence: quarterly, executed at the first weekly close strictly after the decision, matching the frozen long-only book

the_signal_is_unchanged: operating_cash_flow_margin, free_cash_flow_margin and cash_conversion_spread, minimum two features available, ranked sector-neutrally. Taken verbatim from config/sec_independent_fundamental_discovery_v1.json. No feature, minimum or ranking change will be tried; the structure is the only variable.
nothing_will_be_swept: Not breadth, not the long/short split, not the cadence. If the declared configuration fails, the finding is that the structure does not rescue this signal.

windows.out_of_sample: 2013-2022, built from SEC Financial Statement Data Sets, the window the signal was NOT selected on
windows.in_sample: 2023-2026, the window every dashboard strategy was selected on
windows.both_reported_separately: Per CLAUDE.md rule 6. The out-of-sample window is the one that decides this; the in-sample window is reported so the comparison to the frozen book is visible, not because it is evidence.

declared_sign: POSITIVE. The long-short book is hypothesised to earn a positive return net of costs and borrow. A negative result refutes it and will be reported as such rather than inverted.

gates.gate_1_orthogonality: absolute correlation below 0.30 against BOTH the valuation book and the growth leg, measured with src/systematic_trader/return_conventions.load_aligned so the Step 291 offset cannot recur
gates.gate_2_standalone_skill: Sharpe at or above 1.0 out of sample, net of 50bps per leg and 100bps annual borrow
gates.gate_3_beats_its_own_long_only_version: the long-short book must beat the long-only book of the IDENTICAL signal on Sharpe, out of sample. This is the actual hypothesis: if the structure does not improve the same signal, it has added cost and complexity for nothing.
gates.gate_4_market_neutrality_is_real: absolute market beta below 0.30 against SPY

why_gate_3_is_the_hypothesis: Gates 1 and 4 are close to guaranteed by construction -- Step 293 showed a long-short book clears both trivially. Passing them proves only that the arithmetic works. Gate 3 is the only one that can fail informatively, and it is the whole experiment.
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: Borrow is a flat 100bps annual charge. Real borrow is name-specific and is worst on exactly the low-quality names a bottom-decile short leg wants, so this is optimistic and the result is an upper bound.

No short-sale feasibility check. Some bottom-decile names in this universe would be hard or impossible to borrow, and the ones that are hardest to borrow are plausibly the ones with the most short alpha.

The 2013-2022 universe is rebuilt from FSDS filer rosters, a different construction from the in-sample roster, which is why each window's book is compared to its own universe and to its own long-only twin rather than across windows.
Shorting introduces unbounded loss on a single name, which no long-only book here has ever carried. Leave-one-issuer-out on the SHORT leg is mandatory, not optional.
